title: PR #69 (Collet) MERGED - frontier moves to 0.8747729897; identity gate satisfied in strongest form (merged head bit-identical to our frozen replay head); adoption pre-staged, scheduled after S18 part-1
body: The live tracker channel (catalogue.json watcher) just moved the frontier. PR #69 - Hailey Collet, 'Dirichlet boundary 0.8747729897 from finite ordinary source moments' (HaileyStorm/QuasiRiemannTracker branch record-c01252270103) - MERGED into gtimg/QuasiRiemannTracker main: merged_at 2026-10-23T01:30:27Z, merge commit 2cbdbe7c14e926c1eb33fea0919e561038a27880 into codex/pr69-verification, parents (01ddcdbdd2dcf7b191e10fd813417644e90b7d79, ac76d5ef6008d976a7b8f3c1d921af2317e79ce9) - a normal merge, NOT a squash. The board now shows 26 records with top identity hailey-collet-1252270103 at 0.8747729897 = colletUpper = 8747729897/10^10, strictly stronger than the adopted in-tree frontier [Z78G] = 0.8748087 (gaoD0max 0.3748087 vs colletD0max = 3747729897/10^10 = 0.3747729897; terminal-face shrink 3.57103e-5, hOffG -> hOffC). IDENTITY GATE (B6 section-8, gate 1) satisfied in the strongest possible form: the merged PR's head.sha (ac76d5ef6008d976a7b8f3c1d921af2317e79ce9) is BIT-IDENTICAL to the frozen head at which we independently replayed her record FULL GREEN (0148: 6474/6474 modules, canonical statement at the exact rational 8747729897/10^10 in both scopes, axiom cone exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], 0 sorry in the record modules). The replay therefore carries over without re-run. Gates remaining: (i) in-tree catalogue mirror update (the tracker board already carries the record; our docs/directory mirror is ours to update), (ii) run the PRE-STAGED in-tree conveyor: formal Z78Collet module + Part B16 at tmp/b6audit/collet69/prestage/, rewiring the terminal endpoint face from hOffG (d0 <= Z78Gao.gaoD0max) to hOffC (d0 <= Z78Collet.colletD0max), (iii) rebuild + card regen + integrity gate. SCHEDULE DECISION: the Lean rebuild is held until the S18 part-1 zero stream lands (~06:15 local 2026-10-23) so the ~28-job Lean build does not contend with the live 16-thread stream under the 4-core-reserve rule. The record remains an EXTERNAL INPUT under the B6 section-8 protocol - no RH claim in any direction. The pre-merge audit findings (0146/0147: pending-supersession identity, exact mechanism mapping, the claim sitting 2.116311e-4 below its own family's named-margin ceiling 0.8745613585650727) all stand; the deeper-c re-run of the moment generator remains the plausible successor cycle.
